subject: Evaluation environment gating — MAP preflight and VPC peering windows
messages:
From: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Anil Rao <anil.rao@cloudops.io>
Date: 2028-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (target Aug 30)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Verdant is excited to move into an eval. We have a tight timeline and want to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and the POC environment items ASAP so we can hit a target go/no-go on Aug 30. High-level asks from our side:

- API keys and org/project setup (we prefer project-level keys for isolation)
- IP allowlist ranges for outbound and any static egress IPs we should expect
- VPC peering options (are you supporting AWS->AWS peering vs. transit?)
- Any SOC2 evidence we need before data can be seeded

Can you send a draft MAP with the above items, recommended peering windows, and who to loop from your network/security teams? We have Anil (cloud ops) on this thread for network scheduling.

Thanks,
Kelsey

--
Kelsey Turner
Head of Product, Verdant Health
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (target Aug 30)

Kelsey — thanks, and great to push forward. Draft MAP attached (map_v2.xlsx). Summary / immediate answers below and a proposed runbook: 

1) API keys & org setup
   - We can provision project-scoped keys for Verdant. Recommendation: create one project for test data and one for production-like eval to avoid token sprawl.
   - Onboarding step: we need the org admin email + desired project names.

2) IP allowlist / static egress
   - Redwood hosted egress is via a set of static NAT IPs per region. For us-east, the initial allowlist set is 34.200.120.0/24 and 34.200.121.0/24 (we'll confirm exact /32s before peering).

3) VPC peering
   - We support direct AWS VPC peering (same AWS account preferable) + transit gateway. For this POC, direct peering is simplest. See attached diagram (vpc_peering_diagram.png) for route/ASN constraints.

4) Evidence
   - I'll pull SOC2 artefacts and share a redacted bundle.

Proposed timeline / windows:
   - Provision project + test API keys: within 24–48h after org admin confirmed
   - IP allowlist confirmation: we need Verdant's public egress CIDRs by Aug 22 to schedule peering on Aug 24–25
   - Peering window: Aug 24 02:00–06:00 UTC (low traffic), fallback Aug 26 02:00–06:00 UTC

Next steps: I can send the signed MAP (spreadsheet) and a brief checklist for your network team. Who should I put as the point of contact for peering?

Thanks — I attached map_v2.xlsx for the MAP draft.

-priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-17T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (technical notes)

Kelsey / Priyom — quick infra notes from the eng side: 

- API keys: we can issue scoped keys that expire after X days for testing; please confirm whether Verdant wants ephemeral test keys or persistent project keys.
- IP allowlist: Redwood can support IP allowlist at the tenant (org) and project level; we prefer you allow the /24 ranges listed below temporarily then we’ll provide the final /32s during cutover.
  - Candidate egress CIDRs (us-east): 34.200.120.0/24, 34.200.121.0/24
- VPC peering: diagram attached (vpc_peering_diagram.png). Requirements:
  - Both sides must allocate non-overlapping CIDR blocks.
  - For cases where Verdant uses a shared account, route propagation varies with TGW; we recommend direct peering in a dedicated peering account.
- Maintenance window: we have a small maintenance on Aug 25 03:00–05:00 UTC; avoid scheduling during that 2h block.

I'll prepare a short playbook for keys, allowlist steps, and test-call scripts and attach it to the final MAP.

-neha
Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Anil Rao <anil.rao@cloudops.io>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (questions)

Thanks — a few clarifications from our security and cloud teams (Anil copied):

- Static egress: can you confirm the final /32s at least 48h before peering? We need static IPs to configure downstream firewall rules.
- SOC2: please share the redacted SOC2 evidence bundle and a contact for any attestation questions.
- DocuSign: legal wants a cover sheet for the MAP and a short SOW — can you send a DocuSign link?
- Peering window: Aug 24–25 looks tight on our side; can we target Aug 25 06:00–10:00 UTC instead to avoid internal backups?

On the project vs org key question — we prefer project-level keys for the eval.

Kelsey
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-20T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (security & provisioning)

Kelsey — attaching SOC2 evidence stub (security-evidence-SOC2.pdf) and a short onboarding playbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-map. A few concrete items to accept the MAP and provision: 

1) Send the org admin email + preferred project names and we will:
   - Create two projects (verdant-eval-test, verdant-eval-prod-like) and generate project-scoped API keys.
2) IP allowlist finalization: please confirm your public egress CIDRs by Aug 22; we will then issue the final /32s 48h before peering (per your ask).
3) Peering: we can accommodate Aug 25 06:00–10:00 UTC. Avoid the 03:00–05:00 UTC maintenance window noted by Neha.
4) DocuSign: I’ve initiated a DocuSign envelope — link below. Please sign the MAP sheet + quick SOW and we’ll queue the provisioning.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/abcdef-verdant-rdw-contract

If you agree I’ll kick off keys + share test tokens (ephemeral 48h) once we have the signed envelope.

-mina
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Kelsey Turner <kelsey.turner@verdanthq.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Anil Rao <anil.rao@cloudops.io>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP + environment needs for POC (sign-off)

All — thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed the MAP and attachments; everything looks fine. Confirming the following: 

- Verdant will provide public egress CIDRs by 2028-08-22 17:00 UTC (we’ll send Anil’s list)
- We accept the Aug 25 06:00–10:00 UTC peering window.
- I signed the DocuSign envelope just now (you should see a completed status).
- Project names: verdant-eval-test and verdant-eval-prod-like (please proceed).

Next steps for Redwood: provision project keys (ephemeral test keys + persistent project keys) and share test-call steps & allowlist /32s 48h before Aug 25.

I’ll loop in Anil for the final CIDR list.

Kelsey
